title: A Breathless Chase!
text: Imagine running into a field of 7 people all by yourself. They are all trying to catch you, and you have to tag them and come back to your side, all while saying one word continuously without stopping to take a breath! Sounds like a thrilling action movie, doesn't it?

title: Think About It!
text: What would happen if you were tagged by the opponent but you managed to touch the middle line before you ran out of breath? Do you think you would be out, or would they be out?

content.title: The Struggle at the Mid-Line
content.description: Watch as the raider struggles against the defenders, reaching their hand towards the centre line.

title: The Rules of Kabaddi
text: The game you are imagining is Kabaddi! When a player (the raider) enters the opponent's side, they must continuously chant 'Kabaddi, Kabaddi'. If they touch any defenders and return to their half without breaking the chant, those defenders are out. But if the defenders catch the raider before they touch the mid-line, the raider is out!

content.definition_preview: The player who goes into the opponent's half to tag them while chanting.
The defending players whose goal is to catch the raider before they cross the mid-line.

content.title: Breaking the Chant
content.text: A common mistake beginners make is stopping the 'Kabaddi' chant to take a quick breath. If the referee notices you stopping, you are immediately declared OUT!

content.question: What must a player do continuously while in the opponent's half in Kabaddi?
options: Keep chanting 'Kabaddi, Kabaddi' without taking a breath

content.question: What happens if a caught raider manages to touch the centre line?
options: All the catchers holding the raider are out

content.title: Focus on Focus
content.text: Ask students to observe how kabaddi requires both physical agility and intense mental concentration at the same time.

content.title: Reflection: Hold Your Breath!
content.description: Try saying 'Kabaddi, Kabaddi, Kabaddi' as fast as you can. How many times can you say it in a single breath? Imagine doing that while running and trying to escape from being caught!

title: Connecting to Teamwork
text: Kabaddi is not just about individual physical strength. It connects deeply with teamwork and cooperation. Just like ants work together to carry a heavy leaf, the defenders must form a chain and work together in unison to catch a strong raider. You cannot win Kabaddi alone!

content.title: Mastery Challenge: The Kabaddi Strategy
content.description: Draw a small Kabaddi court on paper. Place 7 pebbles on one side (defenders) and 1 on the other (raider). Move the raider pebble and plan how the defenders should surround it. What is the best strategy to catch the raider? Discuss with a friend.
